title: Two-Stage Transfer Learning with Modified VGG16 for Multi-Class Brain Tumor Classification on Heterogeneous MRI
venue: International Conference on Machine Learning and Data Engineering (ICMLDE)
abstract: Presents a two-stage transfer learning protocol addressing cross-scanner domain shift and feature representation collapse in multi-class brain MRI diagnosis. Achieves 97.88% test accuracy across glioma, meningioma, pituitary, and normal scans on heterogeneous clinical benchmarks.
